overview: The Medford City Council and Community Development Board met in a joint session to review and discuss proposed zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue corridor and the Tufts Institutional Zone.

items.title: Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District Zoning (Paper 26093)
items.summary: Referred the proposed zoning amendments for the Boston Avenue Neighborhood Corridor District to the Community Development Board following a presentation on dimensional standards, sub-districts, and parking, as well as extensive feedback from board members, councilors, and the public.

items.title: Tufts Institutional Zone Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the timeline and goals for drafting the Tufts Institutional Zone zoning ordinance, with members agreeing that the process should not be rushed before the end of June.
